lines.en: My mystery game's answers were in plain sight.
The suspects' answer rules lived in the browser.

lines.ko: 소스 보기로 누구나 열어 볼 수 있었죠.
lines.en: Anyone could open them with view source.
lines.art: a detective peeking through a keyhole at a hidden answer sheet

lines.en: Now the answer rules live only on the server.
Ask a question, and the server answers.

lines.ko: 배포할 때 정답이 새면 자동으로 멈춥니다.
lines.en: If answers leak, the deploy stops on its own.
enLines: the deploy stops on its own.
lines.art: a guard stopping a suitcase at a checkpoint barrier

lines.en: Then the Vercel build, which bundles the code, stopped.

lines.ko: 키보드의 역슬래시 하나로 코드가 끝나지 않았죠.
lines.en: One stray backslash key left the code unfinished.

lines.ko: 다음엔 실제 휴대폰으로 끝까지 해 봅니다.
lines.en: Next, I'll play it through on a real phone.
lines.art: a detective holding up a phone to photograph a painting in a museum

lines.en: Now only the server knows the answers.
